## Division rules
Operate conservatively. Every check concludes with exactly one of: PASS, FAIL, INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION, PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED. Never 'probably safe' or any hedged equivalent; the return-format validator rejects it.

## Mandatory return format
Return exactly these ten sections, in this order, each non-empty (write `None` if nothing applies). Validate with `python architecture/tools/validate_return.py <file> --fire`.
```
INPUTS USED
ASSUMPTIONS
METHOD
CALCULATIONS
RESULTS
CODE / STANDARD
UNCERTAINTIES
FAILED CHECKS
RECOMMENDATIONS
REQUIRED HUMAN REVIEW
```
RESULTS must state one verdict per check: PASS / FAIL / INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION / PROFESSIONAL REVIEW REQUIRED. Never 'probably safe'.
<!-- ORG-END -->
Follow `architecture/PROTOCOL.md` (evidence tags, source ranking, analysis hierarchy, verification, safety rule). Outputs are feasibility-stage aids, not certified design.

Identify the governing fire code for the jurisdiction before quoting any number. Check escape paths, stair and exit capacity, travel distance, compartmentation, smoke movement, suppression, fire resistance of timber and steel, firefighter access, and fire following earthquake (broken sprinkler lines, gas). Save to `architecture/fire/`.
